sanskrit: asa̍rji̱ vakvā̱ rathye̱ yathā̱jau dhi̱yā ma̱notā̍ pratha̱mo ma̍nī̱ṣī | daśa̱ svasā̍ro̱ adhi̱ sāno̱ avye 'ja̍nti̱ vahni̱ṁ sada̍nā̱ny accha̍ ||
english: He was released like a skilled charioteer in battle, the first thinker, impelling by thought. The ten sisters upon the woollen filter drive the carrier toward the dwelling places.

sanskrit: vī̱tī jana̍sya di̱vyasya̍ ka̱vyair adhi̍ suvā̱no na̍hu̱ṣye̍bhi̱r indu̍ḥ | pra yo nṛbhi̍r a̱mṛto̱ martye̍bhir marmṛjā̱no 'vi̍bhi̱r gobhi̍r a̱dbhiḥ ||
english: For the feast of the celestial folk, pressed with the wisdom-chants of Nahuṣa's race, flows Indu; he who, immortal among mortal men, is cleansed and polished by the sheep's wool, by the cows' milk, by the waters.

sanskrit: vṛṣā̱ vṛṣṇe̱ roru̍vad a̱ṁśur a̍smai̱ pava̍māno̱ ruśa̍d īrte̱ payo̱ goḥ | sa̱hasra̱m ṛkvā̍ pa̱thibhi̍r vaco̱vid a̍dhva̱smabhi̱ḥ sūro̱ aṇva̱ṁ vi yā̍ti ||
english: The roaring bull-stalk roars to the bull; the Pavamāna sends forth the shining milk of the cow. Equipped with a thousand lauds, the sun-like knower-of-speech travels by unobstructed paths to the narrow passage.

sanskrit: ru̱jā dṛ̱ḻhā ci̍d ra̱kṣasa̱ḥ sadā̍ṁsi punā̱na i̍nda ūrṇuhi̱ vi vājā̍n | vṛ̱ścopari̍ṣṭāt tuja̱tā va̱dhena̱ ye anti̍ dū̱rād u̍panā̱yam e̍ṣām ||
english: Shattering even the firm abodes of the Rakṣasas, O Indu being purified, uncover the prizes. Those who are near or far from approach — smite them from above with the impetuous weapon of the bull-striker.

sanskrit: sa pra̍tna̱van navya̍se viśvavāra sū̱ktāya̍ pa̱thaḥ kṛ̍ṇuhi̱ prāca̍ḥ | ye du̱ḥṣahā̍so va̱nuṣā̍ bṛ̱hanta̱s tām̐s te̍ aśyāma purukṛt purukṣo ||
english: As of old, O all-desired one, make open the eastward paths for the new hymn, for the well-sung praise. Those great ones difficult to vanquish, won by combat — may we obtain them through you, O much-acting, much-nourishing one.

sanskrit: e̱vā pu̍nā̱no a̱paḥ sva1̱̍r gā a̱smabhya̍ṁ to̱kā tana̍yāni̱ bhūri̍ | śaṁ na̱ḥ kṣetra̍m u̱ru jyotī̍ṁṣi soma̱ jyoṅ na̱ḥ sūrya̍ṁ dṛ̱śaye̍ rirīhi ||
english: So flowing purified, fetch us waters, sunlight, and cows; many offspring and progeny. O Soma, may our field be propitious; grant us broad lights; long cause the sun to rise for us to see.

sanskrit: pari̍ suvā̱no hari̍r a̱ṁśuḥ pa̱vitre̱ ratho̱ na sa̍rji sa̱naye̍ hiyā̱naḥ | āpa̱c chloka̍m indri̱yam pū̱yamā̍na̱ḥ prati̍ de̱vām̐ a̍juṣata̱ prayo̍bhiḥ ||
english: The tawny stalk, pressed and flowing around the filter like a chariot released in quest of prizes, attains splendour and power as it is being purified; it has pleased the gods with offerings.

sanskrit: acchā̍ nṛ̱cakṣā̍ asarat pa̱vitre̱ nāma̱ dadhā̍naḥ ka̱vir a̍sya̱ yonau̍ | sīda̱n hote̍va̱ sada̍ne ca̱mūṣūpe̍m agma̱nn ṛṣa̍yaḥ sa̱pta viprā̍ḥ ||
english: Seeing men, the seer has run toward the filter, setting his name in his own birthplace. Sitting in the vessels like a Hotṛ in the seat, the seven inspired seers have come to him.

sanskrit: pra su̍me̱dhā gā̍tu̱vid vi̱śvade̍va̱ḥ soma̍ḥ punā̱naḥ sada̍ eti̱ nitya̍m | bhuva̱d viśve̍ṣu̱ kāvye̍ṣu̱ rantānu̱ janā̍n yatate̱ pañca̱ dhīra̍ḥ ||
english: Forward flows Soma of good intelligence, knower of the way, god of all gods, being purified, ever going to his seat. May the wise one delight in all poetic works; among the five peoples he exerts himself.

sanskrit: tava̱ tye so̍ma pavamāna ni̱ṇye viśve̍ de̱vās traya̍ ekāda̱śāsa̍ḥ | daśa̍ sva̱dhābhi̱r adhi̱ sāno̱ avye̍ mṛ̱janti̍ tvā na̱dya̍ḥ sa̱pta ya̱hvīḥ ||
english: Thine, O Soma Pavamāna, in the secret rite are all the gods — three times eleven. On the woollen back ten streams with natural skill cleanse you; the seven mighty rivers cleanse you.

sanskrit: tan nu sa̱tyam pava̍mānasyāstu̱ yatra̱ viśve̍ kā̱rava̍ḥ sa̱ṁnasa̍nta | jyoti̱r yad ahne̱ akṛ̍ṇod u lo̱kam prāva̱n manu̱ṁ dasya̍ve kar a̱bhīka̍m ||
english: May this be the truth of the Pavamāna — that all the singers have assembled therein. He who made light for the day and created the world, he saved Manu, making the Dasyu fear.

sanskrit: pari̱ sadme̍va paśu̱mānti̱ hotā̱ rājā̱ na sa̱tyaḥ sami̍tīr iyā̱naḥ | soma̍ḥ punā̱naḥ ka̱laśā̍m̐ ayāsī̱t sīda̍n mṛ̱go na ma̍hi̱ṣo vane̍ṣu ||
english: Like a Hotṛ visiting homes rich in cattle, like a true king moving through assemblies, Soma being purified has come to the vessels, settling like a buffalo in the forests.

sanskrit: sā̱ka̱mukṣo̍ marjayanta̱ svasā̍ro̱ daśa̱ dhīra̍sya dhī̱tayo̱ dhanu̍trīḥ | hari̱ḥ pary a̍drava̱j jāḥ sūrya̍sya̱ droṇa̍ṁ nanakṣe̱ atyo̱ na vā̱jī ||
english: The sisters together cleanse him simultaneously — the ten thoughts of the wise one, the bearers. The tawny one has run around; he has hastened to the rays of the sun; he has gained the vessel like a prize racehorse.

sanskrit: sam mā̱tṛbhi̱r na śiśu̍r vāvaśā̱no vṛṣā̍ dadhanve puru̱vāro̍ a̱dbhiḥ | maryo̱ na yoṣā̍m a̱bhi ni̍ṣkṛ̱taṁ yan saṁ ga̍cchate ka̱laśa̍ u̱sriyā̍bhiḥ ||
english: Bellowing like a child with its mothers, the bull, much-desired, has rushed forward with the waters. Like a young man going to meet a woman adorned for pleasure, he comes together with the milch-cows in the vessel.

sanskrit: u̱ta pra pi̍pya̱ ūdha̱r aghnyā̍yā̱ indu̱r dhārā̍bhiḥ sacate sume̱dhāḥ | mū̱rdhāna̱ṁ gāva̱ḥ paya̍sā ca̱mūṣv a̱bhi śrī̍ṇanti̱ vasu̍bhi̱r na ni̱ktaiḥ ||
english: And now has swelled the udder of the inviolable cow; Indu of good wisdom accompanies the streams. The cows bedeck his head with milk in the vessels, as though with treasures newly brightened.

sanskrit: sa no̍ de̱vebhi̍ḥ pavamāna ra̱dendo̍ ra̱yim a̱śvina̍ṁ vāvaśā̱naḥ | ra̱thi̱rā̱yatā̍m uśa̱tī pura̍ṁdhir asma̱drya1̱̍g ā dā̱vane̱ vasū̍nām ||
english: O Pavamāna, together with the gods, bestow on us wealth rich in horses, O longing Indu. May the willing, full-giving abundance, well-directed, come toward us for the giving of goods.

sanskrit: nū no̍ ra̱yim upa̍ māsva nṛ̱vanta̍m punā̱no vā̱tāpya̍ṁ vi̱śvaśca̍ndram | pra va̍ndi̱tur i̍ndo tā̱ry āyu̍ḥ prā̱tar ma̱kṣū dhi̱yāva̍sur jagamyāt ||
english: Now fill us up with wealth abounding in men, as you are purified — wealth from Vātāpa, universally delightful. O Indu, extend the life of the worshipper; may the prayer-wealthy one go forth swiftly in the morning.

sanskrit: adhi̱ yad a̍smin vā̱jinī̍va̱ śubha̱ḥ spardha̍nte̱ dhiya̱ḥ sūrye̱ na viśa̍ḥ | a̱po vṛ̍ṇā̱naḥ pa̍vate kavī̱yan vra̱jaṁ na pa̍śu̱vardha̍nāya̱ manma̍ ||
english: When in him the thoughts contend for glory like mares, like peoples under the sun, then, choosing the waters, he flows as a seer, with insight as a cattle-stall enriching cattle.

sanskrit: dvi̱tā vyū̱rṇvann a̱mṛta̍sya̱ dhāma̍ sva̱rvide̱ bhuva̍nāni prathanta | dhiya̍ḥ pinvā̱nāḥ svasa̍re̱ na gāva̍ ṛtā̱yantī̍r a̱bhi vā̍vaśra̱ indu̍m ||
english: Unfolding doubly the abode of immortality, the worlds spread out for the one who finds the sun. Swelling the prayers like cows gathering at sunset, the ṛta-following ones have cried aloud toward Indu.

sanskrit: pari̱ yat ka̱viḥ kāvyā̱ bhara̍te̱ śūro̱ na ratho̱ bhuva̍nāni̱ viśvā̍ | de̱veṣu̱ yaśo̱ martā̍ya̱ bhūṣa̱n dakṣā̍ya rā̱yaḥ pu̍ru̱bhūṣu̱ navya̍ḥ ||
english: When the seer carries his poetic gifts around all the worlds like a hero in a chariot, newly fresh, seeking to adorn with wealth and power among gods, with renown for mortal man — he is fresh with abundant gifts.

sanskrit: śri̱ye jā̱taḥ śri̱ya ā nir i̍yāya̱ śriya̱ṁ vayo̍ jari̱tṛbhyo̍ dadhāti | śriya̱ṁ vasā̍nā amṛta̱tvam ā̍ya̱n bhava̍nti sa̱tyā sa̍mi̱thā mi̱tadrau̍ ||
english: Born for glory, he has gone forth for glory; he bestows glory and vigour upon his praisers. Those who have clothed themselves in glory have attained immortality; their encounters prove true, their alliances firm.

sanskrit: iṣa̱m ūrja̍m a̱bhy a1̱̍rṣāśva̱ṁ gām u̱ru jyoti̍ḥ kṛṇuhi̱ matsi̍ de̱vān | viśvā̍ni̱ hi su̱ṣahā̱ tāni̱ tubhya̱m pava̍māna̱ bādha̍se soma̱ śatrū̍n ||
english: Flow forth toward us with nourishment and strength; create horse and cow and broad light; gladden the gods. All these things are easy for you to bear, O Pavamāna Soma — you drive away enemies.

sanskrit: kani̍kranti̱ hari̱r ā sṛ̱jyamā̍na̱ḥ sīda̱n vana̍sya ja̱ṭhare̍ punā̱naḥ | nṛbhi̍r ya̱taḥ kṛ̍ṇute ni̱rṇija̱ṁ gā ato̍ ma̱tīr ja̍nayata sva̱dhābhi̍ḥ ||
english: Crying aloud, the tawny one, being released and purified, settles in the belly of the wood. Harnessed by men, he creates the bright robe of the cows; thence with his powers he engenders insights.

sanskrit: hari̍ḥ sṛjā̱naḥ pa̱thyā̍m ṛ̱tasyeya̍rti̱ vāca̍m ari̱teva̱ nāva̍m | de̱vo de̱vānā̱ṁ guhyā̍ni̱ nāmā̱viṣ kṛ̍ṇoti ba̱rhiṣi̍ pra̱vāce̍ ||
english: The tawny one, being released, sets the speech in motion along the path of ṛta, like a rower steering a boat. The god reveals the secret names of the gods upon the sacred grass in the proclamation.

sanskrit: a̱pām i̱ved ū̱rmaya̱s tartu̍rāṇā̱ḥ pra ma̍nī̱ṣā ī̍rate̱ soma̱m accha̍ | na̱ma̱syantī̱r upa̍ ca̱ yanti̱ saṁ cā ca̍ viśanty uśa̱tīr u̱śanta̍m ||
english: Like the waves of the waters rushing forward, the inspirations stream toward Soma. Bowing, they go near and unite, the eager ones entering him who is eager.

sanskrit: tam ma̍rmṛjā̱nam ma̍hi̱ṣaṁ na sānā̍v a̱ṁśuṁ du̍hanty u̱kṣaṇa̍ṁ giri̱ṣṭhām | taṁ vā̍vaśā̱nam ma̱taya̍ḥ sacante tri̱to bi̍bharti̱ varu̍ṇaṁ samu̱dre ||
english: As he is being polished on the back like a buffalo, the stalk — the mountain-dwelling bull — they milk. The inspirations accompany him as he bellows; Trita bears Varuṇa in the ocean.

sanskrit: iṣya̱n vāca̍m upava̱kteva̱ hotu̍ḥ punā̱na i̍ndo̱ vi ṣyā̍ manī̱ṣām | indra̍ś ca̱ yat kṣaya̍tha̱ḥ saubha̍gāya su̱vīrya̍sya̱ pata̍yaḥ syāma ||
english: Inspiring the speech like a prompting priest beside the Hotṛ, O Indu being purified, release the inspiration. And in that you and Indra reign for our well-being — may we become masters of heroic strength.

sanskrit: pra se̍nā̱nīḥ śūro̱ agre̱ rathā̍nāṁ ga̱vyann e̍ti̱ harṣa̍te asya̱ senā̍ | bha̱drān kṛ̱ṇvann i̍ndraha̱vān sakhi̍bhya̱ ā somo̱ vastrā̍ rabha̱sāni̍ datte ||
english: A champion general, at the head of the chariots, he goes seeking cows; his army rejoices. Making good things for Indra-invoking friends, Soma puts on his vigorous garments.

sanskrit: sam a̍sya̱ hari̱ṁ hara̍yo mṛjanty aśvaha̱yair ani̍śita̱ṁ namo̍bhiḥ | ā ti̍ṣṭhati̱ ratha̱m indra̍sya̱ sakhā̍ vi̱dvām̐ e̍nā suma̱tiṁ yā̱ty accha̍ ||
english: The tawny ones cleanse his tawny form, unimpeded by reverences quick as horses. The friend of Indra mounts his chariot; knowing this, he goes toward good favour.

sanskrit: sa no̍ deva de̱vatā̍te pavasva ma̱he so̍ma̱ psara̍sa indra̱pāna̍ḥ | kṛ̱ṇvann a̱po va̱rṣaya̱n dyām u̱temām u̱ror ā no̍ varivasyā punā̱naḥ ||
english: Flow pure for us, O god, at this divine feast, O great Soma, flowing to the place where Indra drinks. Making the waters and raining down the sky and this earth, O being purified, grant us wide relief.

sanskrit: ajī̍ta̱ye 'ha̍taye pavasva sva̱staye̍ sa̱rvatā̍taye bṛha̱te | tad u̍śanti̱ viśva̍ i̱me sakhā̍ya̱s tad a̱haṁ va̍śmi pavamāna soma ||
english: Flow pure for conquest, for invincibility, for well-being, for total wholeness, for greatness. That is what all these friends desire; that is what I, O Pavamāna Soma, desire.

sanskrit: soma̍ḥ pavate jani̱tā ma̍tī̱nāṁ ja̍ni̱tā di̱vo ja̍ni̱tā pṛ̍thi̱vyāḥ | ja̱ni̱tāgner ja̍ni̱tā sūrya̍sya jani̱tendra̍sya jani̱tota viṣṇo̍ḥ ||
english: Soma flows pure — the progenitor of inspirations, the progenitor of heaven, the progenitor of earth, the progenitor of Agni, the progenitor of the sun, the progenitor of Indra, and the progenitor of Viṣṇu.

sanskrit: bra̱hmā de̱vānā̍m pada̱vīḥ ka̍vī̱nām ṛṣi̱r viprā̍ṇām mahi̱ṣo mṛ̱gāṇā̍m | śye̱no gṛdhrā̍ṇā̱ṁ svadhi̍ti̱r vanā̍nā̱ṁ soma̍ḥ pa̱vitra̱m aty e̍ti̱ rebha̍n ||
english: Brahman of the gods, path of the seers, ṛṣi of the inspired poets, buffalo of the beasts, falcon of the vultures, axe of the forests — Soma roaring passes through the filter.

sanskrit: prāvī̍vipad vā̱ca ū̱rmiṁ na sindhu̱r gira̱ḥ soma̱ḥ pava̍māno manī̱ṣāḥ | a̱ntaḥ paśya̍n vṛ̱jane̱māva̍rā̱ṇy ā ti̍ṣṭhati vṛṣa̱bho goṣu̍ jā̱nan ||
english: Soma being purified has swelled the wave of speech like a river, along with hymns and inspirations. Seeing inward the lower enclosures, the bull mounts knowing among the cows.

sanskrit: sa ma̍tsa̱raḥ pṛ̱tsu va̱nvann avā̍taḥ sa̱hasra̍retā a̱bhi vāja̍m arṣa | indrā̍yendo̱ pava̍māno manī̱ṣy a1̱̍ṁśor ū̱rmim ī̍raya̱ gā i̍ṣa̱ṇyan ||
english: Exhilarating, winning in battles, unimpeded, O thousand-seeded one, flow toward the prize. O Indu Pavamāna, of deep thought, stir up the wave of the stalk for Indra, impelling the cows.

sanskrit: pari̍ pri̱yaḥ ka̱laśe̍ de̱vavā̍ta̱ indrā̍ya̱ somo̱ raṇyo̱ madā̍ya | sa̱hasra̍dhāraḥ śa̱tavā̍ja̱ indu̍r vā̱jī na sapti̱ḥ sama̍nā jigāti ||
english: Dear Soma, beloved of the gods, flows around the vessel for the exhilaration of Indra; Indu of a thousand streams, a hundred prizes goes to the assembly like a prize steed.

sanskrit: sa pū̱rvyo va̍su̱vij jāya̍māno mṛjā̱no a̱psu du̍duhā̱no adrau̍ | a̱bhi̱śa̱sti̱pā bhuva̍nasya̱ rājā̍ vi̱dad gā̱tum brahma̍ṇe pū̱yamā̍naḥ ||
english: Primeval, the finder of treasure, as he is born being cleansed in the waters, being milked on the stone — guardian against evil speech, king of the world — as he is purified he finds the path for Brahman.

sanskrit: tvayā̱ hi na̍ḥ pi̱tara̍ḥ soma̱ pūrve̱ karmā̍ṇi ca̱kruḥ pa̍vamāna̱ dhīrā̍ḥ | va̱nvann avā̍taḥ pari̱dhīm̐r apo̍rṇu vī̱rebhi̱r aśvai̍r ma̱ghavā̍ bhavā naḥ ||
english: For through you, O Soma Pavamāna, our wise fathers of old performed their deeds. Winning, unimpeded, throw off the enclosures; become for us a Maghavan with heroes and horses.

sanskrit: yathāpa̍vathā̱ mana̍ve vayo̱dhā a̍mitra̱hā va̍rivo̱vid dha̱viṣmā̍n | e̱vā pa̍vasva̱ dravi̍ṇa̱ṁ dadhā̍na̱ indre̱ saṁ ti̍ṣṭha ja̱nayāyu̍dhāni ||
english: Just as you flowed for Manu, granting vigour, destroying enemies, knowing wide space, offering oblations — so flow now placing wealth, resting in Indra, creating weapons.

sanskrit: pava̍sva soma̱ madhu̍mām̐ ṛ̱tāvā̱po vasā̍no̱ adhi̱ sāno̱ avye̍ | ava̱ droṇā̍ni ghṛ̱tavā̍nti sīda ma̱dinta̍mo matsa̱ra i̍ndra̱pāna̍ḥ ||
english: Flow pure, O sweet Soma of ṛta, wrapping yourself in the waters upon the woollen filter. Settle down into the vessels rich in ghee — most exhilarating, the inebriating one where Indra drinks.

sanskrit: vṛ̱ṣṭiṁ di̱vaḥ śa̱tadhā̍raḥ pavasva sahasra̱sā vā̍ja̱yur de̱vavī̍tau | saṁ sindhu̍bhiḥ ka̱laśe̍ vāvaśā̱naḥ sam u̱sriyā̍bhiḥ prati̱ran na̱ āyu̍ḥ ||
english: Flow pure as the rain from heaven, O hundred-streamed one, thousand-winning, prize-seeking at the divine feast. Crying out together with the rivers and with the dawn-cows in the vessel, extend our lifespan.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa sya somo̍ ma̱tibhi̍ḥ punā̱no 'tyo̱ na vā̱jī tara̱tīd arā̍tīḥ | payo̱ na du̱gdham adi̍ter iṣi̱ram u̱rv i̍va gā̱tuḥ su̱yamo̱ na voḻhā̍ ||
english: This Soma here, being purified with insights, overcomes enmities like a prize horse. Like the milk milked from Aditi — swift, broad as a path, well-controlled like a driver.

sanskrit: svā̱yu̱dhaḥ so̱tṛbhi̍ḥ pū̱yamā̍no̱ 'bhy a̍rṣa̱ guhya̱ṁ cāru̱ nāma̍ | a̱bhi vāja̱ṁ sapti̍r iva śrava̱syābhi vā̱yum a̱bhi gā de̍va soma ||
english: Well-armed, being purified by the pressers, flow toward the secret and beautiful name. Toward the prize like a steed seeking fame, toward Vāyu, toward the cows, O divine Soma.

sanskrit: śiśu̍ṁ jajñā̱naṁ ha̍rya̱tam mṛ̍janti śu̱mbhanti̱ vahni̍m ma̱ruto̍ ga̱ṇena̍ | ka̱vir gī̱rbhiḥ kāvye̍nā ka̱viḥ san soma̍ḥ pa̱vitra̱m aty e̍ti̱ rebha̍n ||
english: The newborn, lovely child they cleanse; the Maruts as a troop adorn the carrier. A seer with hymns, in his poetry a seer, being a seer — Soma roaring passes through the filter.

sanskrit: ṛṣi̍manā̱ ya ṛ̍ṣi̱kṛt sva̱rṣāḥ sa̱hasra̍ṇīthaḥ pada̱vīḥ ka̍vī̱nām | tṛ̱tīya̱ṁ dhāma̍ mahi̱ṣaḥ siṣā̍sa̱n somo̍ vi̱rāja̱m anu̍ rājati̱ ṣṭup ||
english: He who has the mind of a ṛṣi, who makes ṛṣis, winner of the sun, leader of thousands, path of the seers — the buffalo seeking to gain the third station: Soma rules alongside Virāj as a verse.

sanskrit: ca̱mū̱ṣac chye̱naḥ śa̍ku̱no vi̱bhṛtvā̍ govi̱ndur dra̱psa āyu̍dhāni̱ bibhra̍t | a̱pām ū̱rmiṁ saca̍mānaḥ samu̱draṁ tu̱rīya̱ṁ dhāma̍ mahi̱ṣo vi̍vakti ||
english: A falcon, a bird dwelling in the vessel, bearing all, the drop that finds the cows, bearing weapons — following the wave of the waters, the ocean, the buffalo proclaims the fourth station.

sanskrit: maryo̱ na śu̱bhras ta̱nva̍m mṛjā̱no 'tyo̱ na sṛtvā̍ sa̱naye̱ dhanā̍nām | vṛṣe̍va yū̱thā pari̱ kośa̱m arṣa̱n kani̍kradac ca̱mvo̱3̱̍r ā vi̍veśa ||
english: Like a bright youth polishing his body, like a prize horse running to win treasures, like a bull around herds, flowing toward the vessel, crying aloud he has entered the bowls.

sanskrit: pava̍svendo̱ pava̍māno̱ maho̍bhi̱ḥ kani̍krada̱t pari̱ vārā̍ṇy arṣa | krīḻa̍ñ ca̱mvo̱3̱̍r ā vi̍śa pū̱yamā̍na̱ indra̍ṁ te̱ raso̍ madi̱ro ma̍mattu ||
english: Flow pure, O Indu Pavamāna, with great powers; crying aloud, flow around the woollen filters. Playing, enter the bowls as you are being purified; may your inebriating sap exhilarate Indra.

sanskrit: prāsya̱ dhārā̍ bṛha̱tīr a̍sṛgrann a̱kto gobhi̍ḥ ka̱laśā̍m̐ ā vi̍veśa | sāma̍ kṛ̱ṇvan sā̍ma̱nyo̍ vipa̱ścit kranda̍nn ety a̱bhi sakhyu̱r na jā̱mim ||
english: His great streams have flowed forth; anointed with the cows' milk, he has entered the vessels. Making a Sāman, knowing the Sāmans, wise, he comes crying aloud toward his friend like a kinsman.

sanskrit: a̱pa̱ghnann e̍ṣi pavamāna̱ śatrū̍n pri̱yāṁ na jā̱ro a̱bhigī̍ta̱ indu̍ḥ ||
english: Striking down enemies you go, O Pavamāna; praised, Indu comes like a lover to his beloved. Settling in the forests like a bird in flight, Soma being purified sits established in the vessels.

sanskrit: ā te̱ ruca̱ḥ pava̍mānasya soma̱ yoṣe̍va yanti su̱dughā̍ḥ sudhā̱rāḥ | hari̱r ānī̍taḥ puru̱vāro̍ a̱psv aci̍kradat ka̱laśe̍ devayū̱nām ||
english: Your brilliances, O Soma Pavamāna, come like women — good milch-cows, of fine streams. The tawny one, much-desired, brought to the waters, has cried aloud in the vessels of those devoted to the gods.

sanskrit: a̱sya pre̱ṣā he̱manā̍ pū̱yamā̍no de̱vo de̱vebhi̱ḥ sam a̍pṛkta̱ rasa̍m | su̱taḥ pa̱vitra̱m pary e̍ti̱ rebha̍n mi̱teva̱ sadma̍ paśu̱mānti̱ hotā̍ ||
english: Urged by his impulse, urged by his longing, being purified, the god has mixed his sap together with the gods. The pressed one, roaring, goes around the filter like a Hotṛ visiting cattle-rich homes.

sanskrit: bha̱drā vastrā̍ sama̱nyā̱3̱̍ vasā̍no ma̱hān ka̱vir ni̱vaca̍nāni̱ śaṁsa̍n | ā va̍cyasva ca̱mvo̍ḥ pū̱yamā̍na̱ḥ vicakṣa̱ṇo jāgṛ̍vir de̱vavī̍tau ||
english: Wearing fine common garments, the great seer declaiming his utterances — flow into the bowls as you are being purified, far-seeing, wakeful at the divine feast.

sanskrit: sam u̍ pri̱yo mṛ̍jyate̱ sāno̱ avye̍ ya̱śasta̍ro ya̱śasā̱ṁ kṣaito̍ a̱sme | a̱bhi sva̍ra̱ dhanvā̍ pū̱yamā̍no yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: The beloved is cleansed upon the woollen filter, more glorious, the dweller among glorious things in our house. Sound out across the desert as you are being purified — do you always protect us with blessings.

sanskrit: pra gā̍yatā̱bhy a̍rcāma de̱vān soma̍ṁ hinota maha̱te dhanā̍ya | svā̱duḥ pa̍vāte̱ ati̱ vāra̱m avya̱m ā sī̍dāti ka̱laśa̍ṁ deva̱yur na̍ḥ ||
english: Sing forward; let us praise the gods; urge Soma toward great wealth. Sweet he flows through the woollen filter; our god-devoted one settles in the vessel.

sanskrit: indu̍r de̱vānā̱m upa̍ sa̱khyam ā̱yan sa̱hasra̍dhāraḥ pavate̱ madā̍ya | nṛbhi̱ḥ stavā̍no̱ anu̱ dhāma̱ pūrva̱m aga̱nn indra̍m maha̱te saubha̍gāya ||
english: Indu, coming to the friendship of the gods, of a thousand streams, flows pure for exhilaration. Praised by men, following his former station, he has come to Indra for great good fortune.

sanskrit: sto̱tre rā̱ye hari̍r arṣā punā̱na indra̱m mado̍ gacchatu te̱ bharā̍ya | de̱vair yā̍hi sa̱ratha̱ṁ rādho̱ acchā̍ yū̱yam pā̍ta sva̱stibhi̱ḥ sadā̍ naḥ ||
english: Flow, O tawny one being purified, toward wealth for the praiser; may your exhilaration go to Indra for sustenance. Go with the gods in the same chariot toward the gift — do you always protect us with blessings.

sanskrit: pra kāvya̍m u̱śane̍va bruvā̱ṇo de̱vo de̱vānā̱ṁ jani̍mā vivakti | mahi̍vrata̱ḥ śuci̍bandhuḥ pāva̱kaḥ pa̱dā va̍rā̱ho a̱bhy e̍ti̱ rebha̍n ||
english: Proclaiming his poetic craft as Uśanas would, the god declares his birth among the gods. Of great vow, of pure alliance, purifying — roaring, the boar comes forward with steps.

sanskrit: pra ha̱ṁsāsa̍s tṛ̱pala̍m ma̱nyum acchā̱mād asta̱ṁ vṛṣa̍gaṇā ayāsuḥ | ā̱ṅgū̱ṣya1̱̍m pava̍māna̱ṁ sakhā̍yo du̱rmarṣa̍ṁ sā̱kam pra va̍danti vā̱ṇam ||
english: The swans have gone forward toward trefoil and ardour; from hence the bull-hosts have gone home. Friends together declare the roaring chant of the Pavamāna, the hard-to-bear sound.

sanskrit: sa ra̍ṁhata urugā̱yasya̍ jū̱tiṁ vṛthā̱ krīḻa̍ntam mimate̱ na gāva̍ḥ | pa̱rī̱ṇa̱saṁ kṛ̍ṇute ti̱gmaśṛ̍ṅgo̱ divā̱ hari̱r dadṛ̍śe̱ nakta̍m ṛ̱jraḥ ||
english: He rushes with the drive of the wide-goer; the cows do not restrain him playing freely. The sharp-horned one makes abundance; by day the tawny one is seen, by night the bright one.

sanskrit: indu̍r vā̱jī pa̍vate̱ gonyo̍ghā̱ indre̱ soma̱ḥ saha̱ inva̱n madā̍ya | hanti̱ rakṣo̱ bādha̍te̱ pary arā̍tī̱r vari̍vaḥ kṛ̱ṇvan vṛ̱jana̍sya̱ rājā̍ ||
english: Indu the prize horse flows, winning cattle, filling Indra together, Soma for exhilaration. He slays the Rakṣas, drives away enmities on all sides, making wide space — king of the community.

sanskrit: adha̱ dhāra̍yā̱ madhvā̍ pṛcā̱nas ti̱ro roma̍ pavate̱ adri̍dugdhaḥ ||
english: Then mingling with a stream of honey, milked by the stone, he flows through the wool. Indu, enjoying Indra's friendship, the god for the god's exhilaration — intoxicating for delight.

sanskrit: a̱bhi pri̱yāṇi̍ pavate punā̱no de̱vo de̱vān svena̱ rase̍na pṛ̱ñcan | indu̱r dharmā̍ṇy ṛtu̱thā vasā̍no̱ daśa̱ kṣipo̍ avyata̱ sāno̱ avye̍ ||
english: He flows pure toward beloved things, the god mingling the gods with his own sap. Indu, wearing the laws in their proper seasons, with ten finger-strokes has spread himself upon the back of the wool.

sanskrit: vṛṣā̱ śoṇo̍ abhi̱kani̍krada̱d gā na̱daya̍nn eti pṛthi̱vīm u̱ta dyām | indra̍syeva va̱gnur ā śṛ̍ṇva ā̱jau pra̍ce̱taya̍nn arṣati̱ vāca̱m emām ||
english: The red bull cries aloud toward the cows; resounding, he goes along the earth and the sky. Hearkening to Indra's roar in battle, full of wisdom, he flows, sending forth this speech.

sanskrit: ra̱sāyya̱ḥ paya̍sā̱ pinva̍māna ī̱raya̍nn eṣi̱ madhu̍mantam a̱ṁśum | pava̍mānaḥ saṁta̱nim e̍ṣi kṛ̱ṇvann indrā̍ya soma pariṣi̱cyamā̍naḥ ||
english: Rich in sap, swelling with milk, you go stirring the honeyed stalk. O Pavamāna, you go making the continuum, O Soma, being poured round for Indra.

sanskrit: e̱vā pa̍vasva madi̱ro madā̍yodagrā̱bhasya̍ na̱maya̍n vadha̱snaiḥ | pari̱ varṇa̱m bhara̍māṇo̱ ruśa̍ntaṁ ga̱vyur no̍ arṣa̱ pari̍ soma si̱ktaḥ ||
english: So flow pure, inebriating for exhilaration, bowing the fierce-grasped one with weapons. Carrying round the bright complexion, seek our cows, O Soma poured around us.

sanskrit: ju̱ṣṭvī na̍ indo su̱pathā̍ su̱gāny u̱rau pa̍vasva̱ vari̍vāṁsi kṛ̱ṇvan | gha̱neva̱ viṣva̍g duri̱tāni̍ vi̱ghnann adhi̱ ṣṇunā̍ dhanva̱ sāno̱ avye̍ ||
english: Having delighted, O Indu, in well-pathed, easy-going ways, flow pure in the wide space, creating wide room. Knocking away obstacles on all sides like a club, flow upon the ridge along the desert, upon the back of the wool.

sanskrit: vṛ̱ṣṭiṁ no̍ arṣa di̱vyāṁ ji̍ga̱tnum iḻā̍vatīṁ śa̱ṁgayī̍ṁ jī̱radā̍num | stuke̍va vī̱tā dha̍nvā vici̱nvan bandhū̍m̐r i̱mām̐ ava̍rām̐ indo vā̱yūn ||
english: Flow to us the divine, striving rain, rich in refreshment, health-bringing, swift-giving. Finding our way across the desert like a path trodden smooth, O Indu, find these lower kindred, these winds.

sanskrit: gra̱nthiṁ na vi ṣya̍ grathi̱tam pu̍nā̱na ṛ̱juṁ ca̍ gā̱tuṁ vṛ̍ji̱naṁ ca̍ soma | atyo̱ na kra̍do̱ hari̱r ā sṛ̍jā̱no maryo̍ deva dhanva pa̱styā̍vān ||
english: Untie what has been knotted like a knot, O Soma being purified — the straight path and the crooked. Like a racing steed bellowing, the tawny one being released, a young man, O divine one, flows through the desert, rich in home.

sanskrit: juṣṭo̱ madā̍ya de̱vatā̍ta indo̱ pari̱ ṣṇunā̍ dhanva̱ sāno̱ avye̍ | sa̱hasra̍dhāraḥ sura̱bhir ada̍bdhaḥ pari̍ srava̱ vāja̍sātau nṛ̱ṣahye̍ ||
english: Desired for exhilaration, O Indu, at the divine feast, flow around the ridge upon the desert, upon the back of the wool. Of a thousand streams, fragrant, undeceived, flow around in the prize-winning, man-conquering fray.

sanskrit: a̱ra̱śmāno̱ ye̍ 'ra̱thā ayu̍ktā̱ atyā̍so̱ na sa̍sṛjā̱nāsa̍ ā̱jau | e̱te śu̱krāso̍ dhanvanti̱ somā̱ devā̍sa̱s tām̐ upa̍ yātā̱ piba̍dhyai ||
english: Those who are without reins, without chariots, unharnessed — like prize horses let loose in battle — these bright Somas, divine, go running; come to them to drink.

sanskrit: e̱vā na̍ indo a̱bhi de̱vavī̍ti̱m pari̍ srava̱ nabho̱ arṇa̍ś ca̱mūṣu̍ | somo̍ a̱smabhya̱ṁ kāmya̍m bṛ̱hanta̍ṁ ra̱yiṁ da̍dātu vī̱rava̍ntam u̱gram ||
english: So, O Indu, flow around toward the divine feast, a cloud, a flood in the vessels. May Soma give us the desired, great wealth — abounding in heroes, mighty.

sanskrit: takṣa̱d yadī̱ mana̍so̱ vena̍to̱ vāg jyeṣṭha̍sya vā̱ dharma̍ṇi̱ kṣor anī̍ke | ād ī̍m āya̱n vara̱m ā vā̍vaśā̱nā juṣṭa̱m pati̍ṁ ka̱laśe̱ gāva̱ indu̍m ||
english: If the speech of the desirer of mind, or of the eldest in the forefront of the law's field, has fashioned him — then the cows have come, crying for their chosen lord, to find beloved Indu in the vessel.

sanskrit: pra dā̍nu̱do di̱vyo dā̍nupi̱nva ṛ̱tam ṛ̱tāya̍ pavate sume̱dhāḥ | dha̱rmā bhu̍vad vṛja̱nya̍sya̱ rājā̱ pra ra̱śmibhi̍r da̱śabhi̍r bhāri̱ bhūma̍ ||
english: The heavenly giver of gifts, swelling with the gift of dew, of good wisdom, flows pure with ṛta for ṛta. The king of the fold becomes the upholder of law; he shines abundant with ten rays.

sanskrit: pa̱vitre̍bhi̱ḥ pava̍māno nṛ̱cakṣā̱ rājā̍ de̱vānā̍m u̱ta martyā̍nām | dvi̱tā bhu̍vad rayi̱patī̍ rayī̱ṇām ṛ̱tam bha̍ra̱t subhṛ̍ta̱ṁ cārv indu̍ḥ ||
english: The Pavamāna, seeing men, with his filters — king of gods and also of mortals — may he be doubly the lord of riches among riches; may Indu bear ṛta, well borne, beautiful.

sanskrit: arvā̍m̐ iva̱ śrave̍se sā̱tim acchendra̍sya vā̱yor a̱bhi vī̱tim a̍rṣa | sa na̍ḥ sa̱hasrā̍ bṛha̱tīr iṣo̍ dā̱ bhavā̍ soma draviṇo̱vit pu̍nā̱naḥ ||
english: Like a courser to the winning of fame, flow toward the feast of Indra and Vāyu. Being purified, O Soma, knowing wealth, give us a thousand great refreshments.

sanskrit: de̱vā̱vyo̍ naḥ pariṣi̱cyamā̍nā̱ḥ kṣaya̍ṁ su̱vīra̍ṁ dhanvantu̱ somā̍ḥ | ā̱ya̱jyava̍ḥ suma̱tiṁ vi̱śvavā̍rā̱ hotā̍ro̱ na di̍vi̱yajo̍ ma̱ndrata̍māḥ ||
english: Being poured round for the gods, may the Somas impel us toward a hero-rich home. Worship-bringing, all-desired, like Hotṛs sacrificing in heaven — most gladdening ones.

sanskrit: e̱vā de̍va de̱vatā̍te pavasva ma̱he so̍ma̱ psara̍se deva̱pāna̍ḥ ||
english: So, O divine one, flow pure at the divine feast, O great Soma, flowing to where the gods drink. For great is our stake set in the contest; O Soma being purified, set the two worlds in a good place.

sanskrit: aśvo̱ na kra̍do̱ vṛṣa̍bhir yujā̱naḥ si̱ṁho na bhī̱mo mana̍so̱ javī̍yān | a̱rvā̱cīnai̍ḥ pa̱thibhi̱r ye raji̍ṣṭhā̱ ā pa̍vasva saumana̱saṁ na̍ indo ||
english: Like a horse bellowing, yoked with bulls; fearsome like a lion, swifter than thought — by the straightest paths leading hither, O Indu, flow pure bringing good will.

sanskrit: śa̱taṁ dhārā̍ de̱vajā̍tā asṛgran sa̱hasra̍m enāḥ ka̱vayo̍ mṛjanti | indo̍ sa̱nitra̍ṁ di̱va ā pa̍vasva purae̱tāsi̍ maha̱to dhana̍sya ||
english: A hundred divine-born streams have flowed; a thousand the seers cleanse. O Indu, flow pure bringing the gift from heaven; you are the forerunner of great wealth.

sanskrit: di̱vo na sargā̍ asasṛgra̱m ahnā̱ṁ rājā̱ na mi̱tram pra mi̍nāti̱ dhīra̍ḥ | pi̱tur na pu̱traḥ kratu̍bhir yatā̱na ā pa̍vasva vi̱śe a̱syā ajī̍tim ||
english: Like the showers from heaven they have flowed during the days; the wise king does not diminish the covenant. Like a son working with the powers of his father, flow pure, bringing invincibility to this community.

sanskrit: pra te̱ dhārā̱ madhu̍matīr asṛgra̱n vārā̱n yat pū̱to a̱tyeṣy avyā̍n | pava̍māna̱ pava̍se̱ dhāma̱ gonā̍ṁ jajñā̱naḥ sūrya̍m apinvo a̱rkaiḥ ||
english: Your honeyed streams have flowed forward when, purified, you pass beyond the woollen filters. O Pavamāna, you flow as the station of the cows; born, you have swelled the sun with praises.

sanskrit: kani̍krada̱d anu̱ panthā̍m ṛ̱tasya̍ śu̱kro vi bhā̍sy a̱mṛta̍sya̱ dhāma̍ | sa indrā̍ya pavase matsa̱ravā̍n hinvā̱no vāca̍m ma̱tibhi̍ḥ kavī̱nām ||
english: Crying aloud along the path of ṛta, the bright one shines as the abode of immortality. He flows pure, inebriating, for Indra, urging forward the speech with the inspirations of seers.

sanskrit: di̱vyaḥ su̍pa̱rṇo 'va̍ cakṣi soma̱ pinva̱n dhārā̱ḥ karma̍ṇā de̱vavī̍tau | endo̍ viśa ka̱laśa̍ṁ soma̱dhāna̱ṁ kranda̍nn ihi̱ sūrya̱syopa̍ ra̱śmim ||
english: Heavenly fair-winged eagle, O Soma, look down; by your deed swelling the streams at the divine feast. O Indu, enter the soma-holding vessel, crying aloud here near the ray of the sun.

sanskrit: ti̱sro vāca̍ īrayati̱ pra vahni̍r ṛ̱tasya̍ dhī̱tim brahma̍ṇo manī̱ṣām | gāvo̍ yanti̱ gopa̍tim pṛ̱cchamā̍nāḥ soma̍ṁ yanti ma̱tayo̍ vāvaśā̱nāḥ ||
english: The carrier drives forward the three speeches, the thought of ṛta, the inspiration of Brahman. The cows go asking after their cowherd; the inspirations go crying aloud to Soma.

sanskrit: soma̱ṁ gāvo̍ dhe̱navo̍ vāvaśā̱nāḥ soma̱ṁ viprā̍ ma̱tibhi̍ḥ pṛ̱cchamā̍nāḥ | soma̍ḥ su̱taḥ pū̍yate a̱jyamā̍na̱ḥ some̍ a̱rkās tri̱ṣṭubha̱ḥ saṁ na̍vante ||
english: The milch-cows lowing go to Soma; the inspired poets with their insights ask after Soma. Soma pressed and clarified is purified; in Soma the Triṣṭubh verses resound together.

sanskrit: e̱vā na̍ḥ soma pariṣi̱cyamā̍na̱ ā pa̍vasva pū̱yamā̍naḥ sva̱sti | indra̱m ā vi̍śa bṛha̱tā rave̍ṇa va̱rdhayā̱ vāca̍ṁ ja̱nayā̱ pura̍ṁdhim ||
english: So, O Soma being poured around, flow pure toward us with well-being as you are being purified. Enter Indra with a great roar; swell the speech, engender abundance.

sanskrit: ā jāgṛ̍vi̱r vipra̍ ṛ̱tā ma̍tī̱nāṁ soma̍ḥ punā̱no a̍sadac ca̱mūṣu̍ | sapa̍nti̱ yam mi̍thu̱nāso̱ nikā̍mā adhva̱ryavo̍ rathi̱rāsa̍ḥ su̱hastā̍ḥ ||
english: The wakeful inspired one, with the truths of inspirations, Soma being purified, has settled in the vessels. Whom the zealous, intent pairs of Adhvaryus, the well-directed, the skilled-handed, serve with honour.

sanskrit: sa pu̍nā̱na upa̱ sūre̱ na dhātobhe a̍prā̱ roda̍sī̱ vi ṣa ā̍vaḥ | pri̱yā ci̱d yasya̍ priya̱sāsa̍ ū̱tī sa tū dhana̍ṁ kā̱riṇe̱ na pra ya̍ṁsat ||
english: That Soma being purified, like the sun upon its support, has filled both worlds and illuminated them. He whose aids are precious and dear to the dear one — he shall not offer wealth to the ungrateful one.

sanskrit: sa va̍rdhi̱tā vardha̍naḥ pū̱yamā̍na̱ḥ somo̍ mī̱ḍhvām̐ a̱bhi no̱ jyoti̍ṣāvīt | yenā̍ na̱ḥ pūrve̍ pi̱tara̍ḥ pada̱jñāḥ sva̱rvido̍ a̱bhi gā adri̍m u̱ṣṇan ||
english: He, the increaser, the cause of increase, being purified, Soma the bountiful, has shone upon us with light. He through whom our fathers who knew the footsteps, the finders of the sun, drove the cows and heated the stone.

sanskrit: akrā̍n samu̱draḥ pra̍tha̱me vidha̍rmañ ja̱naya̍n pra̱jā bhuva̍nasya̱ rājā̍ | vṛṣā̍ pa̱vitre̱ adhi̱ sāno̱ avye̍ bṛ̱hat somo̍ vāvṛdhe suvā̱na indu̍ḥ ||
english: The ocean has spread forth in the first dispensation, generating creatures — king of the world. The bull, upon the filter upon the back of the wool, the great Soma has grown mighty, Indu being pressed.

sanskrit: ma̱hat tat somo̍ mahi̱ṣaś ca̍kārā̱pāṁ yad garbho 'vṛ̍ṇīta de̱vān | ada̍dhā̱d indre̱ pava̍māna̱ ojo 'ja̍naya̱t sūrye̱ jyoti̱r indu̍ḥ ||
english: Great is what Soma the buffalo has done — when the embryo of the waters chose the gods. The Pavamāna placed power in Indra; Indu engendered light in the sun.

sanskrit: matsi̍ vā̱yum i̱ṣṭaye̱ rādha̍se ca̱ matsi̍ mi̱trāvaru̍ṇā pū̱yamā̍naḥ | matsi̱ śardho̱ māru̍ta̱m matsi̍ de̱vān matsi̱ dyāvā̍pṛthi̱vī de̍va soma ||
english: Gladden Vāyu for sacrifice and prosperity; being purified, gladden Mitra and Varuṇa. Gladden the Marut troop; gladden the gods; O divine Soma, gladden Heaven and Earth.

sanskrit: ṛ̱juḥ pa̍vasva vṛji̱nasya̍ ha̱ntāpāmī̍vā̱m bādha̍māno̱ mṛdha̍ś ca | a̱bhi̱śrī̱ṇan paya̱ḥ paya̍sā̱bhi gonā̱m indra̍sya̱ tvaṁ tava̍ va̱yaṁ sakhā̍yaḥ ||
english: Flow pure as a straight one, killer of the crooked, driving away disease and contempt. Mixing the milk with the milk of the cows — you are Indra's, and we are your friends.

sanskrit: madhva̱ḥ sūda̍m pavasva̱ vasva̱ utsa̍ṁ vī̱raṁ ca̍ na̱ ā pa̍vasvā̱ bhaga̍ṁ ca | svada̱svendrā̍ya̱ pava̍māna indo ra̱yiṁ ca̍ na̱ ā pa̍vasvā samu̱drāt ||
english: Flow pure as the spring of honey-sweetness; flow toward us with heroic power and good fortune. Being purified, O Indu, make it sweet for Indra; flow toward us with wealth from the ocean.

sanskrit: soma̍ḥ su̱to dhāra̱yātyo̱ na hitvā̱ sindhu̱r na ni̱mnam a̱bhi vā̱jy a̍kṣāḥ ||
english: Soma pressed, pouring in a stream like a horse released, like a river rushing toward the low ground, prize-winning, has reached the mark. Being purified, he has settled in the wild native place; Indu has met the cows together, met the waters.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa sya te̍ pavata indra̱ soma̍ś ca̱mūṣu̱ dhīra̍ uśa̱te tava̍svān | sva̍rcakṣā rathi̱raḥ sa̱tyaśu̍ṣma̱ḥ kāmo̱ na yo de̍vaya̱tām asa̍rji ||
english: Here, O Indra, this Soma flows for you in the vessels — wise, mighty for the desiring one. Seeing the sun-light, well-directed, of true strength — like a desire he has been released among those devoted to the gods.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa pra̱tnena̱ vaya̍sā punā̱nas ti̱ro varpā̍ṁsi duhitur dadhā̍naḥ | vasā̍na̱ḥ śarma̍ tri̱varū̍tham a̱psu hote̍va yāti̱ sama̍neṣu̱ rebha̍n ||
english: This one being purified with ancient vigour, setting his beauty through the forms of his daughter, wearing the three-fold protective shelter among the waters, goes roaring at the assemblies like a Hotṛ.

sanskrit: nū na̱s tvaṁ ra̍thi̱ro de̍va soma̱ pari̍ srava ca̱mvo̍ḥ pū̱yamā̍naḥ | a̱psu svādi̍ṣṭho̱ madhu̍mām̐ ṛ̱tāvā̍ de̱vo na yaḥ sa̍vi̱tā sa̱tyama̍nmā ||
english: Now, O divine Soma well-directed, flow around the bowls as you are being purified. Sweetest in the waters, honey-rich, possessed of ṛta — like the divine Savitṛ who is true in thought.

sanskrit: a̱bhi vā̱yuṁ vī̱ty a̍rṣā gṛṇā̱no̱3̱̍ 'bhi mi̱trāvaru̍ṇā pū̱yamā̍naḥ | a̱bhī nara̍ṁ dhī̱java̍naṁ rathe̱ṣṭhām a̱bhīndra̱ṁ vṛṣa̍ṇa̱ṁ vajra̍bāhum ||
english: Flow toward Vāyu for his feast while being praised, being purified; toward Mitra and Varuṇa. Toward the man swift of thought standing in the chariot; toward Indra the bull, the thunderbolt-armed.

sanskrit: a̱bhi vastrā̍ suvasa̱nāny a̍rṣā̱bhi dhe̱nūḥ su̱dughā̍ḥ pū̱yamā̍naḥ | a̱bhi ca̱ndrā bharta̍ve no̱ hira̍ṇyā̱bhy aśvā̍n ra̱thino̍ deva soma ||
english: Flow toward fine, well-worn garments; being purified, toward good milch-cows. Toward bright gold for us to carry; toward chariot-horses, O divine Soma.

sanskrit: a̱bhī no̍ arṣa di̱vyā vasū̍ny a̱bhi viśvā̱ pārthi̍vā pū̱yamā̍naḥ | a̱bhi yena̱ dravi̍ṇam a̱śnavā̍mā̱bhy ā̍rṣe̱yaṁ ja̍madagni̱van na̍ḥ ||
english: Flow toward us with the divine goods, being purified, toward all earthly goods as well. Toward that by which we may attain wealth; toward the noble heritage like Jamadagni.

sanskrit: a̱yā pa̱vā pa̍vasvai̱nā vasū̍ni mām̐śca̱tva i̍ndo̱ sara̍si̱ pra dha̍nva | bra̱dhnaś ci̱d atra̱ vāto̱ na jū̱taḥ pu̍ru̱medha̍ś ci̱t taka̍ve̱ nara̍ṁ dāt ||
english: By this purification, flow pure bringing these goods; O Indu, advance upon the lake. Even here the ruddy one is driven like wind; even the much-wise one gave a man to the swift.

sanskrit: u̱ta na̍ e̱nā pa̍va̱yā pa̍va̱svādhi̍ śru̱te śra̱vāyya̍sya tī̱rthe | ṣa̱ṣṭiṁ sa̱hasrā̍ naigu̱to vasū̍ni vṛ̱kṣaṁ na pa̱kvaṁ dhū̍nava̱d raṇā̍ya ||
english: And with this purification, flow pure for us upon the famous ford of the praiseworthy. Sixty thousands of treasures, as though shaking a ripe tree for battle.

sanskrit: mahī̱me a̍sya̱ vṛṣa̱nāma̍ śū̱ṣe mām̐śca̍tve vā̱ pṛśa̍ne vā̱ vadha̍tre | asvā̍payan ni̱guta̍ḥ sne̱haya̱c cāpā̱mitrā̱m̐ apā̱cito̍ ace̱taḥ ||
english: Great are the bull-names of this one in his strength — whether in the Māṃścatva or the Pṛśana weapon. He lulled the secrets to sleep and gave them unction; the mindless, backward enemies he turned away.

sanskrit: saṁ trī pa̱vitrā̱ vita̍tāni̱ eṣy anv eka̍ṁ dhāvasi pū̱yamā̍naḥ | asi̱ bhago̱ asi̍ dā̱trasya̍ dā̱tāsi̍ ma̱ghavā̍ ma̱ghava̍dbhya indo ||
english: You pass through three spread-out filters; you run along one as you are being purified. You are Bhaga, you are the giver of the gift, you are Maghavan for those who have gifts, O Indu.

sanskrit: e̱ṣa vi̍śva̱vit pa̍vate manī̱ṣī somo̱ viśva̍sya̱ bhuva̍nasya̱ rājā̍ | dra̱psām̐ ī̱raya̍n vi̱dathe̱ṣv indu̱r vi vāra̱m avya̍ṁ sa̱mayāti̍ yāti ||
english: This omniscient, inspired Soma flows pure — king of all the world. Stirring the drops at the assemblies, Indu goes passing the woollen filter at the same time.

sanskrit: indu̍ṁ rihanti mahi̱ṣā ada̍bdhāḥ pa̱de re̍bhanti ka̱vayo̱ na gṛdhrā̍ḥ ||
english: The unfailing buffaloes lick Indu; the seers roar in their place like eagles. The wise ones urge him on with ten movements; they anoint his form with the essence of the waters.

sanskrit: tvayā̍ va̱yam pava̍mānena soma̱ bhare̍ kṛ̱taṁ vi ci̍nuyāma̱ śaśva̍t | tan no̍ mi̱tro varu̍ṇo māmahantā̱m adi̍ti̱ḥ sindhu̍ḥ pṛthi̱vī u̱ta dyauḥ ||
english: Through you, O Soma Pavamāna, may we always gather in what has been wrought in battle. May Mitra and Varuṇa magnify that for us — Aditi, Sindhu, Earth, and Heaven.

sanskrit: a̱bhī na̍vante a̱druha̍ḥ pri̱yam indra̍sya̱ kāmya̍m | va̱tsaṁ na pūrva̱ āyu̍ni jā̱taṁ ri̍hanti mā̱tara̍ḥ ||
english: Flow toward us, O prize-winning one, with wealth most longed for by many, yielding a thousand things, mighty in fame, all-conquering.

sanskrit: pari̱ ṣya su̍vā̱no a̱vyaya̱ṁ rathe̱ na varmā̍vyata | indu̍r a̱bhi druṇā̍ hi̱to hi̍yā̱no dhārā̍bhir akṣāḥ ||
english: That pressed one has wrapped around the woollen garment like armour on a chariot. Indu, fixed in his rush, hurried, has attained the mark with his streams.

sanskrit: pari̱ ṣya su̍vā̱no a̍kṣā̱ indu̱r avye̱ mada̍cyutaḥ | dhārā̱ ya ū̱rdhvo a̍dhva̱re bhrā̱jā naiti̍ gavya̱yuḥ ||
english: That pressed Indu, the shedder of exhilaration, has reached his mark in the wool. The stream which goes upward at the sacrifice, bright, does not tire, seeking the cows.

sanskrit: sa hi tvaṁ de̍va̱ śaśva̍te̱ vasu̱ martā̍ya dā̱śuṣe̍ | indo̍ saha̱sriṇa̍ṁ ra̱yiṁ śa̱tātmā̍naṁ vivāsasi ||
english: For you, O divine one, ever seek to bestow goods upon the mortal worshipper. O Indu, you woo a thousandfold wealth, a hundredfold in its nature.

sanskrit: va̱yaṁ te̍ a̱sya vṛ̍traha̱n vaso̱ vasva̍ḥ puru̱spṛha̍ḥ | ni nedi̍ṣṭhatamā i̱ṣaḥ syāma̍ su̱mnasyā̍dhrigo ||
english: O Vṛtra-slayer, O wealth-lord, of wealth longed for by many — may we be nearest of all to your refreshments, unimpeded in your grace.

sanskrit: dvir yam pañca̱ svaya̍śasa̱ṁ svasā̍ro̱ adri̍saṁhatam | pri̱yam indra̍sya̱ kāmya̍m prasnā̱paya̍nty ū̱rmiṇa̍m ||
english: Twice five sisters self-glorious, the one compacted by the stone — dear and desired by Indra, the wavy one — they bathe and cleanse.

sanskrit: pari̱ tyaṁ ha̍rya̱taṁ hari̍m ba̱bhrum pu̍nanti̱ vāre̍ṇa | yo de̱vān viśvā̱m̐ it pari̱ made̍na sa̱ha gaccha̍ti ||
english: Around the lovely, tawny, brown one they purify with the woollen filter — he who goes encompassing all the gods together with exhilaration.

sanskrit: a̱sya vo̱ hy ava̍sā̱ pānto̍ dakṣa̱sādha̍nam | yaḥ sū̱riṣu̱ śravo̍ bṛ̱had da̱dhe sva1̱̍r ṇa ha̍rya̱taḥ ||
english: With his protection drink this power-accomplishing one. He who has laid up great renown among the patrons — the lovely one, like the sun.

sanskrit: sa vā̍ṁ ya̱jñeṣu̍ mānavī̱ indu̍r janiṣṭa rodasī | de̱vo de̍vī giri̱ṣṭhā asre̍dha̱n taṁ tu̍vi̱ṣvaṇi̍ ||
english: He, Indu, was born as a human offering at your sacrifices, O Heaven and Earth. The divine and the divine ones, dwelling on the mountain — inexhaustible they roar toward that loud-thundering one.

sanskrit: indrā̍ya soma̱ pāta̍ve vṛtra̱ghne pari̍ ṣicyase | nare̍ ca̱ dakṣi̍ṇāvate de̱vāya̍ sadanā̱sade̍ ||
english: O Soma, you are poured around for Indra to drink — the Vṛtra-slayer — and for the man of right hand, the divine one, who sits in the seat.

sanskrit: te pra̱tnāso̱ vyu̍ṣṭiṣu̱ somā̍ḥ pa̱vitre̍ akṣaran | a̱pa̱protha̍ntaḥ sanu̱tar hu̍ra̱ścita̍ḥ prā̱tas tām̐ apra̍cetasaḥ ||
english: Those ancient Somas have flowed at the dawns through the filter, spreading out far, oblique, pressed in the morning — those the heedless ones did not understand.

sanskrit: taṁ sakhāyaḥ puro̱ruca̍ṁ yū̱yaṁ va̱yaṁ ca̍ sū̱raya̍ḥ | a̱śyāma̱ vāja̍gandhyaṁ sa̱nema̱ vāja̍pastyam ||
english: That one who shines in front — may you friends and we patrons attain the prize-scented one; may we win the prize-rich home.

sanskrit: ā ha̍rya̱tāya̍ dhṛ̱ṣṇave̱ dhanu̍s tanvanti̱ pauṁsya̍m | śu̱krāṁ va̍ya̱nty asu̍rāya ni̱rṇija̱ṁ vi̱pām agre̍ mahī̱yuva̍ḥ ||
english: For the lovely, bold one they stretch the bow of manliness. The great ones in the forefront of the waters weave a bright garment for the powerful lord.

sanskrit: adha̍ kṣa̱pā pari̍ṣkṛto̱ vājā̍m̐ a̱bhi pra gā̍hate | yadī̍ vi̱vasva̍to̱ dhiyo̱ hari̍ṁ hi̱nvanti̱ yāta̍ve ||
english: Then through the night, decorated, he plunges forward toward prizes — when the thoughts of Vivasvat urge on the tawny one to go.

sanskrit: tam a̍sya marjayāmasi̱ mado̱ ya i̍ndra̱pāta̍maḥ | yaṁ gāva̍ ā̱sabhi̍r da̱dhuḥ pu̱rā nū̱naṁ ca̍ sū̱raya̍ḥ ||
english: We cleanse for him that exhilaration which is most fit for Indra to drink — which the cows have placed with their mouths of old, and the patrons do now.

sanskrit: taṁ gātha̍yā purā̱ṇyā pu̍nā̱nam a̱bhy a̍nūṣata | u̱to kṛ̍panta dhī̱tayo̍ de̱vānā̱ṁ nāma̱ bibhra̍tīḥ ||
english: With an ancient song they have praised him as he is being purified. And the prayers bearing the names of the gods have lamented.

sanskrit: tam u̱kṣamā̍ṇam a̱vyaye̱ vāre̍ punanti dharṇa̱sim | dū̱taṁ na pū̱rvaci̍ttaya̱ ā śā̍sate manī̱ṣiṇa̍ḥ ||
english: Him, as he is dripping in the woollen filter, the bearing one, they purify. Like an envoy, the inspired ones instruct him with foremost thought.

sanskrit: sa pu̍nā̱no ma̱dinta̍ma̱ḥ soma̍ś ca̱mūṣu̍ sīdati | pa̱śau na reta̍ ā̱dadha̱t pati̍r vacasyate dhi̱yaḥ ||
english: He being purified, most exhilarating, Soma, sits in the vessels. Like seed placed in an animal, the lord calls forth the prayers.

sanskrit: sa mṛ̍jyate su̱karma̍bhir de̱vo de̱vebhya̍ḥ su̱taḥ | vi̱de yad ā̍su saṁda̱dir ma̱hīr a̱po vi gā̍hate ||
english: He is polished by skilful workers, the god pressed for the gods. He plunges through the great waters as one who makes them overflow — this is perceived in them.

sanskrit: su̱ta i̍ndo pa̱vitra̱ ā nṛbhi̍r ya̱to vi nī̍yase | indrā̍ya matsa̱rinta̍maś ca̱mūṣv ā ni ṣī̍dasi ||
english: O Indu, pressed and poured into the filter, led about and guided by men — most exhilarating for Indra, you settle into the vessels.

sanskrit: a̱bhī na̍vante a̱druha̍ḥ pri̱yam indra̍sya̱ kāmya̍m | va̱tsaṁ na pūrva̱ āyu̍ni jā̱taṁ ri̍hanti mā̱tara̍ḥ ||
english: The guileless ones press forward toward the dear and desired of Indra; like mothers licking their newborn calf at first life, they lick him.

sanskrit: pu̱nā̱na i̍nda̱v ā bha̍ra̱ soma̍ dvi̱barha̍saṁ ra̱yim | tvaṁ vasū̍ni puṣyasi̱ viśvā̍ni dā̱śuṣo̍ gṛ̱he ||
english: O Indu being purified, bring us, O Soma, wealth of double strength. You nourish all goods in the house of the worshipper.

sanskrit: tvaṁ dhiya̍m mano̱yuja̍ṁ sṛ̱jā vṛ̱ṣṭiṁ na ta̍nya̱tuḥ | tvaṁ vasū̍ni̱ pārthi̍vā di̱vyā ca̍ soma puṣyasi ||
english: Release the prayer harnessed to the mind like rain from thunder. O Soma, you nourish earthly and heavenly goods.

sanskrit: pari̍ te ji̱gyuṣo̍ yathā̱ dhārā̍ su̱tasya̍ dhāvati | raṁha̍māṇā̱ vy a1̱̍vyaya̱ṁ vāra̍ṁ vā̱jīva̍ sāna̱siḥ ||
english: The stream of you who have conquered, of the pressed one, runs around; rushing, it passes through the woollen filter like a prize horse seeking the prize.

sanskrit: kratve̱ dakṣā̍ya naḥ kave̱ pava̍sva soma̱ dhāra̍yā | indrā̍ya̱ pāta̍ve su̱to mi̱trāya̱ varu̍ṇāya ca ||
english: Flow pure with your stream for our will and discernment, O wise Soma. You are pressed for Indra to drink, and for Mitra and Varuṇa.

sanskrit: pava̍sva vāja̱sāta̍maḥ pa̱vitre̱ dhāra̍yā su̱taḥ | indrā̍ya soma̱ viṣṇa̍ve de̱vebhyo̱ madhu̍mattamaḥ ||
english: Flow pure, most prize-winning, pressed through the filter in a stream. Most honey-rich, O Soma, for Indra, for Viṣṇu, for the gods.

sanskrit: tvāṁ ri̍hanti mā̱taro̱ hari̍m pa̱vitre̍ a̱druha̍ḥ | va̱tsaṁ jā̱taṁ na dhe̱nava̱ḥ pava̍māna̱ vidha̍rmaṇi ||
english: The guileless mothers lick you, O tawny one, in the filter — like milch-cows licking a newborn calf, O Pavamāna, in the dispensation.

sanskrit: pava̍māna̱ mahi̱ śrava̍ś ci̱trebhi̍r yāsi ra̱śmibhi̍ḥ | śardha̱n tamā̍ṁsi jighnase̱ viśvā̍ni dā̱śuṣo̍ gṛ̱he ||
english: O Pavamāna, you travel with great renown, with bright rays. You smite all the darknesses in the house of the worshipper, overpowering them.

sanskrit: tvaṁ dyāṁ ca̍ mahivrata pṛthi̱vīṁ cāti̍ jabhriṣe | prati̍ drā̱pim a̍muñcathā̱ḥ pava̍māna mahitva̱nā ||
english: O you of great vow, you have upheld heaven and earth. You, O Pavamāna, have loosened the cloak by your greatness.
